title: Google\Cloud\SecretManager\V1\ReplicationStatus\UserManagedStatus\ReplicaStatus
name: ReplicaStatus
description: Describes the status of a user-managed replica for the [SecretVersion][google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.SecretVersion].

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.location
params.description: Output only. The canonical ID of the replica location. For example: "us-east1".

params.name: data.customer_managed_encryption
params.description: Output only. The customer-managed encryption status of the [SecretVersion][google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.SecretVersion]. Only populated if customer-managed encryption is used.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Output only. The canonical ID of the replica location.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Output only. The canonical ID of the replica location.

methods.name: getCustomerManagedEncryption
methods.description: Output only. The customer-managed encryption status of the [SecretVersion][google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.SecretVersion]. Only populated if customer-managed encryption is used.

methods.name: setCustomerManagedEncryption
methods.description: Output only. The customer-managed encryption status of the [SecretVersion][google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.SecretVersion]. Only populated if customer-managed encryption is used.
